description: One Cards block; the variant is a block option (Cards (variant[, option])). Each variant keeps its code and styles in variants/<option>.{js,css}.

variants.usageDescription: Default Block Collection cards: grid of bordered cards, image (4:3, cover) above a text body.

visualCharacteristics.purpose: linked product / service cards in a 3-column grid
visualCharacteristics.description: No existing cards variants in blocks/. White bordered cards on grey, 3 per row, centered contained product image (not cropped), centered light-weight title, description + bullet list, whole card clickable.

contentPattern.summary: 7 linked product/service cards in a wrapping 3-column grid
contentPattern.structure: two cells: (1) product image (contained, centered, not cropped), (2) title heading wrapping a link to the detail page, a description paragraph and a bulleted feature list; the title link makes the whole card clickable

cells: Title heading (linked) + description paragraph + bulleted list

variants.reuseGuidance: Use for product series / category listings that link to detail pages. For text-only boxes use cards-faq.
variants.usageDescription: Grid of product or service cards, each with an image, a linked title, a short description and a feature list. The whole card links to the title link target.

visualCharacteristics.purpose: static, always-open question/answer boxes stacked full width
visualCharacteristics.description: Differs from cards-product (under 80% similar): text only, one card per row at full width, grey filled boxes, no images or links on the card. Uses the cards 'no images' one-cell content model.

contentPattern.structure: one cell: a question heading (bold) followed by one or more answer paragraphs (inline links allowed); no image

variants.reuseGuidance: Use for static FAQ lists where every answer is always visible. For collapsible Q&A use accordion.
variants.usageDescription: Stacked full-width grey boxes, each holding one question heading and its answer.

visualCharacteristics.purpose: Static, borderless, centered benefit tiles: red line icon, bold title, short description; 4 across desktop, 2x2 mobile
visualCharacteristics.description: cards-product is bordered, linked product cards with contained photos and feature lists (3/row); cards-faq is text-only full-width boxes; cards-scroll is a horizontal scroll strip; accordion-icon-grid tiles expand on click. These are static, borderless, centered icon + title + one-line description tiles, 4/row: under 80% similar to any.

contentPattern.summary: 4 benefit tiles: red line icon (150x150), bold title, short description; 4 across desktop, 2x2 on mobile
contentPattern.structure: one row per tile: (1) icon image; (2) bold title paragraph + description

variants.reuseGuidance: Use for benefit/feature icon rows. For tiles that expand use accordion-icon-grid.
variants.usageDescription: Static, borderless, centered benefit tiles: red line icon, bold title, short description; 4 across desktop, 2x2 mobile.

visualCharacteristics.purpose: Wrapping 4/2/1 grid of document cards: bold title above a bordered cover thumbnail, red outline "Read" button
visualCharacteristics.description: Closest is Biomek cards-scroll (document covers linking to assets) but that is a single-row horizontal scroll strip with hover 'Download' overlays and no titles above the image; cards-product is bordered product cards with image first. This is a wrapping 4/row grid, title on top, cover image, visible outline 'Read' button: under 80% similar.

contentPattern.summary: 9 application-note cards in a wrapping 4-column grid: bold title, document cover thumbnail, red outline 'Read' button; each links to its application-note detail page
contentPattern.structure: one row per card: (1) cover image (optionally linked); (2) bold title paragraph + "Read" link

variants.reuseGuidance: Use for application notes / resource listings. For a horizontal strip use cards-scroll.
variants.usageDescription: Wrapping 4/2/1 grid of document cards: bold title above a bordered cover thumbnail, red outline "Read" button.

visualCharacteristics.purpose: Single-row horizontal scroll strip: brochure covers with a hover "Download" overlay link, or application tiles (landscape image, red eyebrow, bold linked title)
visualCharacteristics.description: vs cards-product (~45%): single-row horizontal scroll strip, no description/list, portrait covers with hover 'Download' overlay. Shared with the Explore Applications strip (s4-4): same strip layout; text cell optional. | Horizontal-scroll strip of 10 linked tiles: landscape image + red eyebrow label + bold title; whole tile clickable.

contentPattern.summary: Horizontal-scroll strip of 6 brochure cover images; hover reveals a 'Download' overlay link to the PDF/asset | Horizontal-scroll strip of 10 linked tiles: landscape image, red 'Webpage' label, bold title; the whole tile links to the application page
contentPattern.structure: one row per tile: (1) image; (2) a single download link, or eyebrow paragraph + linked title

variants.reuseGuidance: Use for brochure/download strips and linked tile strips. For a wrapping grid use cards-product or cards-resource.
variants.usageDescription: Single-row horizontal scroll strip: brochure covers with a hover "Download" overlay link, or application tiles (landscape image, red eyebrow, bold linked title).

visualCharacteristics.purpose: One-column list of documents: type icon (PDF / video), bold blue title link opening in a new tab, optional one-line ellipsis description; Resource Type filter and pagination built from the rows
visualCharacteristics.description: Same component and layout (single-column list, leading icon, linked bold title). The extra description line per item is an extra paragraph the block handles. Icon differs (fa-video here vs fa-file-pdf on 6000): the block should pick the icon per item or use one neutral document icon.

contentPattern.summary: 5 resource rows stacked full width: blue video icon, bold blue linked title, one-line grey description (ellipsis-truncated); Resource Type filter and pagination container / Filterable, paginated list of 3 gated-media documents, each a PDF icon + bold blue linked title / Filterable list of 5 documents: type icon (PDF / video), bold linked title, one-line truncated description; 'Filter by: Resource Type' dropdown above, pagination container below
contentPattern.structure: one row per document: (1) type cell: "pdf" or "video" (select field `type`); (2) rich text `text`: title link paragraph + optional description paragraph

variants.reuseGuidance: Use for product-page "Content and Resources" document lists. For a cover-image grid use cards-resource; for a two-column bordered download list use cards-downloads.
variants.usageDescription: One-column list of documents: type icon (PDF / video), bold blue title link opening in a new tab, optional one-line ellipsis description; Resource Type filter and pagination built from the rows.

visualCharacteristics.purpose: Two-column grid of white bordered rows: title link on the left, resource type label and "| PDF" download link with a red download icon on the right
visualCharacteristics.description: cards-resource (Cydem VT) is a 4/row grid with cover thumbnails and a 'Read' button; cards-faq is full-width grey Q&A boxes. This is a text-only 2-column list of compact white bordered rows with title left and type label + PDF icon link right: under 80% similar.

contentPattern.summary: 12 bordered text rows in a 2-column grid: document title link (application-note page or PDF), 'Application Note' type label, '| PDF' red download-icon link
contentPattern.structure: one row per document, one rich text cell `text`: title link paragraph + type label paragraph (e.g. "Application Note") + optional link-only paragraph "PDF" pointing at the PDF

variants.reuseGuidance: Use for application-note / document download lists without images. For a single-column filterable list use cards-doclist.
variants.usageDescription: Two-column grid of white bordered rows: title link on the left, resource type label and "| PDF" download link with a red download icon on the right.

visualCharacteristics.purpose: 2x2 grid of grey text cards with a 4px red-to-purple gradient top border, heading, text and a right-aligned red outline button; hover lift
visualCharacteristics.description: cards-faq is grey text-only boxes but stacked full width, left grey border, no button; cards-icon is borderless icon tiles 4/row; cards-resource/cards-product carry images. This is 2/row text cards with a gradient top border and a right-aligned outline CTA, hover lift: under 80% similar to all.

contentPattern.summary: 4 grey cards in a 2x2 grid (1/row mobile), 4px red-to-purple gradient top border, title, paragraph, right-aligned red outline button; each links to a detail page
contentPattern.structure: one row per card, one rich text cell `text`: heading (h3) + paragraph(s) + em-wrapped link (outline button)

variants.reuseGuidance: Use for 2-up "explore more" link cards without images. For static Q&A boxes use cards-faq.
variants.usageDescription: 2x2 grid of grey text cards with a 4px red-to-purple gradient top border, heading, text and a right-aligned red outline button; hover lift.

visualCharacteristics.purpose: Centred bordered step cards: photo on top, full-width coloured label bar (purple, navy, cyan by position), short description; "exchange" option draws → / ← arrows between two cards
visualCharacteristics.description: cards-product has linked titles and lists; cards-icon is borderless icon tiles; cards-resource is title-over-cover with Read button. This is unlinked photo-top cards with a per-position coloured label bar (purple, navy, cyan) under the image: under 80% similar.

contentPattern.summary: 3 centered bordered step cards: cover photo, full-width coloured label bar (purple / navy / cyan, uppercase), short description / 2 step cards ('With Carousel' purple bar, 'With Plate' cyan bar) with a stacked → / ← arrow pair between them
contentPattern.structure: one row per card: (1) image (`image`/`imageAlt`); (2) rich text `text`: bold label paragraph (e.g. FIRST STEP) + description paragraph

variants.reuseGuidance: Use for short illustrated process steps. Add the Exchange option for a two-card swap (bars purple then cyan). For linked numbered product steps use cards-workflow.
variants.usageDescription: Centred bordered step cards: photo on top, full-width coloured label bar (purple, navy, cyan by position), short description; "exchange" option draws → / ← arrows between two cards.

visualCharacteristics.purpose: One row of numbered workflow steps with grey chevrons between them: coloured number badge + step name, product image, product name; whole tile links to the product with a grey hover; stacks on mobile
visualCharacteristics.description: Closest is cards-icon (4 across, image + title + text) but this is an ordered process strip: numbered colored square badges beside the step name, chevron separators between items, whole tile linked with a #f5f5f5 hover, left-aligned header row above a full-width image. Under 80% similar to cards-icon, cards-product (bordered product cards) and cards-scroll (horizontal scroll strip).

contentPattern.summary: 4 linked workflow steps in one row with grey chevrons between: colored numbered badge + bold step name (Media preparation / Gradient generation / Centrifugation / Band extraction), product image, product name (OptiMATE Gradient Media / OptiMATE Gradient Maker / Optima XPN Ultracentrifuge / OptiXTRACT Sample Recovery Aid); grey hover background; stacks on mobile
contentPattern.structure: one row per step: (1) product image (`image`/`imageAlt`); (2) rich text `text`: bold step name paragraph + product name link paragraph. The block numbers the steps

variants.reuseGuidance: Use for linked product workflows (step 1..n). For unlinked photo step cards use cards-steps.
variants.usageDescription: One row of numbered workflow steps with grey chevrons between them: coloured number badge + step name, product image, product name; whole tile links to the product with a grey hover; stacks on mobile.

visualCharacteristics.purpose: Bordered linked tiles: image on top, centred title below, whole tile clickable
visualCharacteristics.description: Equal-width tiles in one row (16px gap) from 768px, stacked at 80% below. Optional eyebrow badge (#545454, 12px) over a red gradient image area with a contained 88px thumbnail. Option panels: 4-column wrapping grid, grayscale photos, bold 14px titles.

contentPattern.summary: Application tiles (cover photo + title), resource tiles (badge + thumbnail + title), Related Content panels
contentPattern.structure: one row per tile: (1) image; (2) optional eyebrow paragraph + linked title paragraph

variants.reuseGuidance: Use for rows of linked tiles with an image and a short title. Add panels for a wrapping Related Content grid.
variants.usageDescription: Bordered linked tiles: image on top, centred title below; optional eyebrow badge; panels option for a 4-column Related Content grid.
